title: Smart Notes App
problem: Traditional note-taking applications often lack secure authentication and organized cloud-based note management.
impact: Built a full-stack MERN note management platform with JWT authentication, REST APIs, MongoDB Atlas integration, and scalable backend architecture for secure and efficient note organization.

title: BioVault – Secure Biomedical Data Portal
problem: Managing sensitive biomedical data requires secure authentication and controlled access to protect critical information.
impact: Developed a secure biomedical data portal with Firebase Authentication, role-based access management, and protected workflows for handling sensitive datasets.

title: IngreGenius – Recipe Recommendation Platform
problem: Users often struggle to discover recipes using the ingredients they already have available.
impact: Built a recipe discovery platform with ingredient-based search, Firebase-powered data management, and filtering functionality to simplify meal planning.
